notes.title: Update Notes for v1.13
notes.notes: * Stability patch - I've fixed a few of the reported crashes

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.12
notes.notes:
Fixed a variety of crashes introduced in the last major patch
 Fixed several small bugs
 No longer showing deprecated items in inventory
 Fixed "Child born!" text when child gets older
 You can now only request the current or next day off work (requesting more than one day in advance wasn't working as expected)
 Fixed selecting of pets

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.11
notes.notes:
Fixed rotation of pre-placed objects in homes
 Fixed bug where pet food options weren't shown
 Tuned parenting balance, made it easier to keep kids happy

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.1
notes.notes:
Players can now have a child with their partner
 Characters now age and eventually pass away
 Your spouse now contributes their income to the household
 Added schools
 Added nannies, who you can pay to look after your kids
 Players can ask their partner to take care of their child
 When your character passes away, you can now choose to continue as one of your children. Your new character inherits some of their parent's net worth.
 Added option for diagonal placement of some objects (if they don't have an "access tile" then you can usually place them diagonally)
 Added toys for kids (different sets for babies, toddlers and teenagers)
 Added cribs for babies to sleep in
 Added option to rename your kids/pets
 Changed raw chicken to be more deadly and less enjoyable
 Fixed an issue where being beautiful was seen as a negative for romantic encounters
 Fixed your own spouse inviting you for dinner at your house
 Fixed glow on other characters' vehicles
 Fixed name and placement of the "decorative fan" object
 Rainy/stormy weather is now much less common
 Fixed various issues with object selection
 Fixed a bug where clothing stats wouldn't update immediately if you chose to wear an item you had just bought

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.04
notes.notes:
Version 1.04 is now live on Steam ːsteamhappyː

I'm now starting work on v1.1, which will include the ability for players to have kids.


 Players now get a sleep/rest buff from their marriage/dating partner being at their house
 When at the Pawn Shop, there's now some text to indicate which of the player's items are currently placed in their home
 The "Books" tab is now visible even when players don't have the required items for their books - it'll warn the player that they require the items on mouse hover
 Fixed some text alignment issues
 Fixed bug where character previews wouldn't get rendered after closing the Invite window
 Reduced tiredness accumulation rate by 20%

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.03
notes.notes:
Fixed memory leaks which caused a variety of game crashes
 Optimized texture sizes

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.02
notes.notes:
Added a button to work for your full shift, rather than holding down the mouse button to work
 Fixed issue where the player could get stuck without a recruitment card in the LETWare mission
 Fixed various crashes
 Added some details to the tutorial about top-down navigation, pausing and the in-game manual
 Added tips to in-game manual
 Fixed bug with "Bootleg Fashion" mission

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.998
notes.notes:
Overhauled vehicle physics
 Added various weather conditions
 Improved shaders
 Added dynamic skybox which changes with time of day & weather
 Added new vehicles to purchase
 Added new vehicle paint system
 Added several ramps throughout the town, and a mission sequence to ramp over them for cash
 Added "Sale" icons above shops which currently have active sales
 Sale discounts are now also shown when the player hovers their mouse over locations
 The top-down camera now tilts upwards slightly when zooming in
 Added several camera distance settings for manual driving
 Edible foods are now ordered correctly, with the most recent items first
 Fixed bug with mouse scroll-wheel not working on certain UI elements
 Fixed various bugs with saving/loading
 Lots of other bug-fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.997
notes.notes:
Added several new mission strands
 Added various characters around the town
 Question marks will show above locations when there is a character waiting to talk to you
 More friend-based missions
 Spacebar will now cancel navigation when in top-down mode

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.995
notes.notes:
Players can now view all of their acquired items via the Character Window
 Added a win condition - you can now complete Little Lives when you get the maximum score in each category!
 Increased the earnings from jobs, particularly at higher ranks
 Re-balanced some of the requirements for the "Home" stat
 Cooking is now less demanding and more rewarding (ingredients are less expensive, food is more nourishing)
 Friends now invite you to different types of events - not just walks in the forest!
 Added option for players to try to meet new friends at various different locations
 Added dialogue option to "unfriend" a contact (removes them from your contact list)
 Added option to give up your pets for adoption
 Improved the location names & descriptions
 Added particle effects for certain pop-up messages
 Various UI improvements
 Removed vehicle damage & repairs
 Your rented/owned home now has a distinct icon
 Old saves which didn't get the correct recipes when finishing certain education should now have those recipes
 Added new up-market hotel/restaurant in the Downtown area
 Added some new sound effects
 Fixed some bugs with vehicle audio
 Fixed a bug where the "Home" stat indicator didn't update when placing items in your home
 Fixed a bug with rent payments going out at the wrong time

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.992
notes.notes:
NPCs will now change clothes when they go to work
 Stock history is now sorted by date, with the most recent transactions appearing at the top
 Changed certain ingredients so that they never go off
 Changed all food types to last longer before going off
 When food goes off, the food item details are now shown in the on-screen message
 The amount of rent due is now shown in the finances screen
 The player will no longer get thrown out of their apartment on the first time they fail to pay rent - they get one chance to pay it late
 Fixed a bug with "rent due tomorrow" warnings sometimes not showing
 Rent & mortgage will now only be taken during the daytime, so players don't get kicked out of their apartment in the middle of the night
 Limited the clothes that some NPCs wear, so they aren't dressed like firefighters/policemen/etc (this won't affect old saves)
 Added option to pay back half your bank loan
 Slightly increased starting cash
 Fixed a few minor bugs

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.99
notes.notes:
Added cooking: 20 ingredients & 20 recipes to cook
 Added crafting: you can combine various components to construct simple objects for your home
 Added ability to repair items
 Added Hardware shop
 Added foraging: search for random items at the park, forest & beach
 You can now order takeaway food from the comfort of your home
 Mood now goes up if you eat delicious food
 Mood now goes down if you eat the same food type too often
 Reworked & rebalanced skills
 Added "yoga" skill
 Improved the book shop interface
 Added popup daily events - positive/negative popups that sometimes appear at the start of your day
 Added option to take time off work
 Increased the cash rewards for completing objectives
 Added achievements for cooking, crafting & repairing
 Added menu option for UI Scaling
 Your mood now suffers if your pet dies
 Made the cat meow audio less annoying
 Fixed bug where benches weren't placeable
 Fixed bug with building opening times
 Fixed numerous other small bugs

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.982
notes.notes:
Added 13 new breeds of dogs
 Pet breeds now have ratings for energy & appetite
 Contacts who like/dislike pets will be charmed/offended by your pets
 More expensive pets will impress friends more
 Replaced gift system - characters no longer want specific items. Instead you can buy gifts and give them to whoever you choose.
 Added a bunch of gifts, including a Love Potion
 Added a gift shop
 Added a hairdresser
 Items now have "tags" to indicate what they're for
 Shops will now occasionally have discounted sales
 Fixed bug with partner not moving in with you after marriage
 Fixed bug with multiple characters rendering on top of each other
 Fixed some jitteriness in the driving simulation
 Added a more expensive laptop type which increases study efficiency even more
 Some items have differing effects based on quality (eg. more expensive fridge stores food for longer)
 Added a toggle to disable wall-hiding when viewing your apartment

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.98
notes.notes:
Added in-game stock market & crypto trading
 The stock market can be accessed at the bank
 If you have a computer, both the stock market & crypto trading can be accessed at home
 When you buy a newspaper, occasionally you'll get an investment tip
 Your friends will occasionally give you investment tips (they're not always right!)
 Fixed occasional bug with vehicle rotations
 Fixed bug with color gradients in text
 Fixed bug with resolution detection

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.974
notes.notes:
Updated the user interface to be more consistent
 New game logo!
 Replaced most of the old music with new tracks
 Made some of the new activities less lucrative (playing gigs & playing in chess tournaments) - they were paying far too much!
 Fixed bug where the effect of playing with or feeding your pets wasn't visible until you'd done it twice
 Playing with your pet now also reduces loneliness
 Fixed various mission-related text messages
 Missions involving an NPC will no longer trigger if you've got an upcoming social event with that character
 Fixed bug with duplicate items when the player failed to pay rent
 Fixed some level-of-detail issues with the trees

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.973
notes.notes:
You can now play a gig at the bar or play in a chess tournament at the bookshop, and earn money based on your skills.
 You can now do odd-jobs like stack shelves at the Grocery Store or walk dogs at the park/beach/forest
 Fixed an issue with auto-detecting resolution (resulted in blurry image for some players)
 You can now cancel sleeping/resting by pressing Escape
 Sleeping is now more effective
 Your home's Entertainment & Lighting scores now contribute towards your mood regeneration
 There are now costs for organising various social events - more expensive restaurants have higher cost
 Hunger is now reduced if you go to a "dinner" social event
 Guests now complain about or compliment the appearance, entertainment & lighting of your apartment. This affects your relationship with them.
 Added Materialistic trait, which makes NPCs care more about the Appearance of your home
 Outside of home events, guests will now complain about or compliment social event venues if you're the organiser
 Feeding your pet now takes 30 minutes
 Showering now takes 20 minutes
 Playing with your pet now improves your mood
 Friends will no longer invite you out directly before or after a shift at work
 Slightly reduced work times for the initial ranks of careers
 Fixed bug with "matching cards" challenge
 Added Grocery Store in the downtown area

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.971
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where characters sometimes appear on top of each other
 Fixed bug where ordering challenges were sometimes broken
 Chairs are now accessible from all sides
 Fixed bug where the location wasn't accessible when going to meet a friend at the forest, park or beach
 Fixed bug where pressing escape from the Invite window would sometimes hang the game
 Fixed bug where driving too far along the beach would cause the game to crash
 Added Color Blind option to settings

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.97
notes.notes:
This is a huge update, adding hundreds of unique items with which to decorate your home. Please let me know if you encounter any bugs or have any feedback!


 Added hundreds of new items: tables, chairs, decor, mirrors, art, lighting, electronics, etc
 Added several new shops
 Expanded the game map to include a new area
 Many items also have color variations
 Occupants of a home are now shown inside it
 Some items can be placed on tables/surfaces
 Ceiling lights are now available to buy
 Icons are now shown instead of text for buyable items
 Optimization of world geometry
 Improved water rendering
 Statistics are now tracked for home furnishings & decorations
 Reduced invite frequency from friends
 Fixed bug where the "Pay off mortgage" achievement was not granted if you paid in cash for a property
 Added button to delete save games

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.963
notes.notes:
Fixed various bugs
 Added camera option to disable zooming into buildings
 Added camera option to disable swaying

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.961
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for v0.961 (12th October 2022)


 Fixed several hangs & crashes
 Added "Clock Display" options (12hr or 24hr time)
 Pets are now less needy
 Friends are now slightly less strict about arriving on time to their events

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.96
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for v0.96 (6th October 2022)


 Added new area to the map
 Players can now purchase various properties
 Added Pawn Shop, where you can buy & sell assorted used goods
 Fixed up various UI elements
 Beds are no longer comically oversized
 Added several new achievements
 Fixed shadow ranges in overhead view
 Added pet shop, where players can purchase cats & dogs
 Doing overtime at your workplace will now always increase your Job Performance
 Added orange outlines to clothing stats to indicate work requirements
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.951
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for v0.951 (24th July 2022)

This is mostly a small bugfix patch while I continue working on the next set of features.


 Added "Cleanliness" state. Players need to shower regularly, otherwise they won't be able to work and their relationships will suffer.
 Fixed a bug where players couldn't go to the beach location.
 Fixed issue where a player's contacts were all the same gender.
 Fixed a few serialization issues.

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.95
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for v0.95 (30th April 2022)


 The traffic system has been rewritten. Cars in top-down mode will now avoid each other, stop at intersections, etc
 Added a "Scheduler" so that players can see a list of relevant upcoming events
 Added shortcuts to navigate to home/work ('1' and '2' respectively)
 Reduced frequency of friends calling to invite you out
 "Loud neighbours" mission no longer triggers in more expensive apartments
 Fixed a bug where the Work tooltip wouldn't stay open if you hovered the mouse over it
 Fixed a bug where the "Annoyed" state would never get removed

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.942
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for v0.942 (20th March 2022)

• Fixed crash relating to meeting NPCs
• Fixed issue where an event invite could have an invalid date
• Fixed various bugs with the Invite window
• Fixed various serialization issues
• Fixed a bug in the "Hospital Transplant" mission

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.941
notes.notes:
Version 0.941 is now live, with all of the new changes to the social system. Old save games unfortunately won't work - you'll need to start a new game with this patch.

Changes:

 New social system for interacting with NPCs
 NPCs that you meet are now visible on the map, and have their own schedule, job, social events, etc
 Organise social events with multiple NPCs (eg. can organise a house party with 6 people)
 Choose from a set of "cards" to select your social responses
 Collect cards during gameplay for special responses (eg. "Good news" card when you get a promotion, "Scandal" card when you read a tabloid/newspaper)
 Start dating, get married, make your significant other jealous, make enemies!
 NPCs also organise events (sometimes without you)
 NPCs have randomized traits and interests
 NPCs have various desired items (can gift desired items to them to increase relationship)
 Various improvements to the UI
 Tooltip popups for every item/building/character in the game
 Many other things I can't remember!

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.901
notes.notes:
Version 0.901 is now live. It includes a complete overhaul of the career system, with 9 distinct career paths to choose from. Old save games unfortunately won't work - you'll need to start a new game with this patch.

Changes:

Added 9 career paths, each with 9 ranks (Technology, Science, Politics, Music, Crime, Healthcare, Hospitality, Law Enforcement, Sales)
Added multiple job-specific missions per career
Added multiple skills, each with 6 ranks to level up
Added hobby shop, which sells items to improve your skills (chessboard, weight bench, etc)
Added bookshop, which sells books to improve your skills
Added various new buildings to support the new careers
Added blue indicator in clock to show when your work shift starts/ends
"High School" is now "Community College", and offers a variety of courses to improve your skills
Added minigame challenges (these can be disabled via the options menu)
Jobs now have varying stress levels
Changed overhead view to be more angled, rather than top-down
Changes to the map to make certain routes shorter
Added character window which shows all of your skills/stats
Work & home are now highlighted with different colours on the map
Fixed bug with learning multipliers not stacking correctly
Added achievement for reaching the top of any career
Added pause button
Added information windows to indicate when your work shift starts/ends
Slider to control how much effort you put into your job
Can only work on certain days of the week, varying per job
Loads of small fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.88
notes.notes:
Version 0.88 is now live. It includes full character customization and a new clothing system. Old save-games should work... but no guarantees, as this was a fairly big change!

Now that these changes are finally in, the next update will focus on improving the career system.

Changes:

 Character customization
 New clothing system
 Items of clothing can be arranged into Outfits in your apartment
 Your character is now shown in the bottom right (can also view their current outfit & switch between outfits from this UI)
 NPCs are randomly generated using the same character customization functionality
 Full views of characters are shown during dialogue
 Purchasing a closet gives the player more outfit slots
 New stores added for hats, shoes and sunglasses
 Each job now requires a specific dress code (based on clothing stats)
 Fixed various visual pops/glitches
 Added tutorial information for the various clothes-related features
 Added many new character animations
 Fixed bug with outlines displaying incorrectly at different aspect ratios
 Increased number of credits required for each level of High School
 Added an option to skip the tutorial
 Sleeping now removes fatigue more slowly
 A bunch more stuff I can't remember

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.87
notes.notes:
Patch 0.87 is now live, and primarily introduces an auto-driving mode. You can press spacebar to toggle between the "normal" driving and a top-down view where you can click on buildings to navigate to them.


Top-down auto-driving mode
Added 1 new music track
Tweaked the driving simulation to make it more fun
Tweaked the frequency of friends contacting you
Reduced ambient mission frequency
Various mission tweaks
Removed taxi functionality from previous patch, as it's redundant with the auto-driving mode
Added options to set display resolution and toggle V-sync
Reduced rent for the low-income apartment
Various buildings are now open for longer hours
Fixed a bug where load/save wouldn't work on some non-English configurations
Made various UI elements more responsive
Fixed an issue where skipping time was slower at lower framerates
Fixed various issues with the navigation line indicator
You can now rotate items with the mouse-wheel when placing them
Reduced the cost of the Flat Tyre mission

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.86
notes.notes:
Version 0.86 is out! Please let me know on the forums if you run into any issues. Here's the changelist:


 General optimization
 Added graphics options
 Added gameplay options
 Made time update more slowly when driving
 Work/home quick-access icons on map
 Taxi system
 Fixed inconsistent updating of time/clock
 Lowered penalties for crash with police car
 Updated food to show how long it has left before it goes off
 Fixed a bug where food lifetime wasn't saved correctly
 Added notification when you buy clothes
 UI: Fixed duration strings
 UI: Fixed tooltips showing underneath other UI elements
 Changed "Week of food" items to last longer
 Reduced clothing deterioration rate
 Added support for arrow keys to control vehicle
 Cleaned up building UI to show groups & sub-groups
 Fixed bug with Character Creator where it wouldn't reset your trait points if you closed the window and came back
 Added another clothes store in the Downtown area
 Altered tutorial to demonstrate how to use a taxi
 Reduced time used when phoning a friend
 Fixed issues with placing computer desk
 Made apartments bigger
 Fixed bug when reloading certain save games
 Improved text for Mattress Shopping mission
 The job info panel now shows which clothes are required for that job
 Progress bars for stats now also show the numerical value for that stat
 The wealth panel now also shows the amount of rent that you need to pay, and how long until it is due
 Locations on the minimap now show the hours that they are open
 Fixed a bug where clicking on locations on the minimap wouldn't expand the map
 Reduced cost of cheapest apartment
 Fixed bug where your new job title wouldn't show when promoted

notes.title: Release Day
notes.notes:
Little Lives is now available in Early Access on Steam!

Thank you for your support, and please leave a review if you like the game!
